Team —

We are at the point where MidWest Bank is asking for a firm delivery commitment to close their Q4 agreement. Procurement has listed two gating items we don’t currently have as first-class features:

- Tenant-level routing isolation (ability to route traffic for MWB to isolated serving path to meet compliance)
- Audit export with immutable event stream and faster export window (up to 90 days granular logs)

Customer context: Sarah Nolan (legal/compliance) and Tom Reeves (platform) flagged these as mandatory on Friday; they will not sign until it’s either implemented or we provide an approved SLA exception in writing. We have the mutual action plan attached (MWB_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf). Contract deadline they gave: 2026-11-30.

Ask: can Eng/Product triage and tell me:
1) Scope definition for each ask (technical approach + minimal MVP)
2) Rough ETA/effort (weeks / engineer-weeks) if we prioritize this in the next sprint cycle
3) Risk and any blockers (security review, infra capacity, compliance sign-off needed)

We are prepared to offer a moderate ACV bump and a limited-term credit for prioritization; I need an answer to communicate to procurement by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks —
Ben

Subject: Re: Request: prioritize connection isolation + audit logs for Midwest Bank (deal MWB-2026-Q4-001)

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Quick technical reactions (high level):

1) Tenant-level routing isolation: we have two possible approaches:
   a) Config-only routing layer change (fast): carve a separate routing table + dedicated pool label for MWB. Low-risk but still shares underlying GPU tenant resources; needs careful KV cache invalidation. Estimated MVP: 2 sprints (approx 4 engineer-weeks) to add routing flags, tests, and ops playbook.
   b) Hard isolation (full tenant lanes + network isolation): heavier; requires infra and deploy model variant pinning. Estimated: 6-8 weeks + infra approvals.

2) Audit export: we already stream events to internal telemetry; exposing an immutable export with 90-day granularity is mostly an access/export surface and retention config. We should be able to deliver a curated export (S3 sink + signed manifest) in ~2 weeks (2 engineer-weeks) assuming legal OKs about retention.

Blocking questions:
- Expected qps/traffic shape for MWB (peak tokens/sec, concurrency).
- Do they require model pinning/quantization guarantees for deterministic output?
- Are we comfortable with an interim SLA exception to buy time for full isolation? If yes, ops needs an explicit playbook for failover.

I'll sync with infra on ENG-1289 tomorrow morning and can sketch a minimal plan.

— Dev
Dev Patel | Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

- Offer a documented SLA exception (timeboxed 90 days) with specific mitigations

Phase B (permanent solution):
